title: Build a Component Runtime
short_description: Prepare and run component instances without implementing a DOM renderer yet.
description: The starter defines types and small helpers so you can focus on coordinating an instance.
Implement a pedagogical runtime that classifies inputs, runs setup with context, and connects events, dependencies, and lifecycle.
instructions: Complete createComponentInstance(vnode, parent) with its own identity, parent/root relationships, separate stores, and an inheritable provides registry.
Complete setupComponent(instance) so it separates props and attrs, normalizes slots, and runs setup while the instance is active.
Interpret the setup result: store objects as setupState and functions as render.
Complete emit so it runs the normalized listener left by the parent in the VNode props.
Complete provide and inject through the active instance registry and a prototype chain.
Register onMounted and onUnmounted on the instance; mountComponent and unmountComponent must invoke them in the correct order.
Keep resetRuntime working so every test starts without an active instance or previous identifiers.

hints.title: Instance record
hints.body: Create different objects for `props`, `attrs`, `slots`, and `setupState`. When a parent exists, `root` must point to `parent.root`.

hints.title: Setup context
hints.body: Save the previous active instance, assign the new one before calling `setup`, and restore the previous one when it finishes.

hints.title: Provides inheritance
hints.body: An instance can initially share `parent.provides`. When `provide` runs, create `Object.create(parentProvides)` before writing if both registries are still the same object.

hints.title: Lifecycle
hints.body: `onMounted` and `onUnmounted` only append callbacks to the active instance. Mount obtains `subTree` from `render`; unmount runs final hooks and marks the instance.
